newsitem.title: USA: Group says cuts Boston Technology stake.
newsitem.headline: Group says cuts Boston Technology stake.

text.p: Orient Star Holdings and its parent Carso Global Telecom S.A. de C.V. said Monday they have reduced their stake in Boston Technology Inc to 6.04 percent or 1,530,200 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the companies said their latest transactions include the sale of 355,000 shares of Boston Technology between October 17 and November 29 at prices ranging from $15.875 to $19.625 a share.
The Mexico-based group holds its stake in the Wakefield, Mass.,-based computer systems and software company for investment purposes.
